name: How long does it take to remove mold from air vents?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove mold from air vents?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to remove mold from air vents can vary significantly. A smaller, contained mold issue in accessible vents might be resolved in a few hours. However, more extensive mold growth throughout the entire duct system, especially if it's hidden or difficult to access, could take one to several days. This includes the initial inspection, containment setup, mold removal, cleaning, and post-remediation verification. Your technician will provide a more precise timeline after assessing the scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold removal from air vents can take from a few hours for minor issues to several days for extensive or hidden mold, including inspection and remediation.
